newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GZI Transport shrs seen in HK$2.84-HK$3.06 range.
newsitem.headline: GZI Transport shrs seen in HK$2.84-HK$3.06 range.

text.p: GZI Transport Ltd, an infrastructural spinoff of Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd, is expected to price its shares in an initial range of HK$2.84 to HK$3.06 per share, market sources said on Friday.
GZI is expected to issue 250 million new shares in a global offering and will be the first red-chip infrastructural concern to be listed on the Hong Kong bourse, they said.
Sources said GZI is expected to kick off its road show in Hong Kong early next week before heading to Europe, the United States and Singapore later in the week.
Listing of the shares is expected later in January or in early February, they said.
Guangzhou Investment's spokesman declined to comment.

GZI has six toll road projects, mainly in China's southern Guangdong province, with a value based on future net cash flow of about HK$2.80 billion. Five of the six projects will be fully operational this year.
In December, Guangzhou Investment said the Hong Kong stock exchange had approved in principle the listing of GZI.

Guangzhou Investment said new shares with warrants in the proportion of one GZI warrant for every five GZI shares would be offered in a placement to international institutional investors and a public offering in Hong Kong.
The public offer also includes a preferential offer to Guangzhou Investment shareholders on the basis of one GZI share for every 51 Guangzhou Investment shares held.
There will also be an over-allotment option to be exercised by lead underwriter Peregrine to issue an additional 15 percent of the new shares.

Guangzhou Investment said its stake in GZI will be reduced to not more than 38.25 percent after the listing from 51 percent. It said the listing will provide GZI with additional financial resources to expand its toll road business.
Guangzhou Investment shares were up HK$0.10 to HK$3.85 at midday on Friday.
